    WHERE ([c0].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [c0].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [c0].[DeleteDate] IS NULL AND [m].[Id] = [c0].[MangaId]) AS [TotalChapters], CASE

    ELSE [t].[ViewCount]

    SELECT AVG(CAST([m0].[Rating] AS float))
    FROM [MangaRating] AS [m0]
    WHERE ([m0].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [m0].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [m0].[DeleteDate] IS NULL AND [m].[Id] = [m0].[MangaId]) AS [AverageRating], (
